title: SDLC Reference Resolution v2
description: Closed JSON response envelope for resolving a reference and, optionally, a bounded number of additional reference rounds into one flat references map.
$comment: Depth defaults to one. The root resolution retains its data and stores every additional successful resolution directly under references, keyed by the exact reference string. Reference entries never contain nested references maps; duplicate reference strings are resolved at most once.

schema.description: The canonical depth-aware resolution response schema identifier.

ref.description: The reference supplied to the resolver.

valid.description: Whether the root reference resolved to a document and data.

resolution.description: The root resolved document, selected data, and flat additional reference map, or null on root failure.

fullPath.description: Absolute path to the root containing document.

repositoryPath.description: Repository-relative path to the root containing document.

format.description: Serialization format of the root containing document.

data.description: The root object or property selected by the reference.

references.description: Flat map of additional resolved references keyed by exact reference string. Values never contain another references property.

findings.description: Actionable root or expanded-reference findings; empty for complete success.
examples: Referenced WI-0007-10000000: Task document not found for task UID: WI-0007-10000000

ReferenceResolution.description: One flat additional reference resolution. It deliberately has no references property.

fullPath.description: Absolute path to the referenced containing document.

repositoryPath.description: Repository-relative path to the referenced containing document.

format.description: Serialization format of the referenced containing document.

findings: Task-local references require an explicit current-task context and cannot be resolved by this command.
